name: run2-dock-scrolled-dark
js: (async () => { const b=document.querySelector('.convomsgs'); if(b){ b.scrollTop=b.scrollHeight; b.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')); } await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1400)); })()
